verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, so browser-operating agent capability is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence shows Poke driving a web browser to research or complete tasks on websites. The 'Send to Poke' right-click action only sends text into Poke, app integrations and MCP tools are different capabilities, and human taskers handling bookings or orders is not browser automation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
